prepared: 2026-10-18, held out; written before any rw.repo.query implementation existed. Expected answers derived by hand from the builder, not from rw.repo code.
notes: Each expected_citation is at the question's revision unless it carries its own 'revision'. Lines are 1-based inclusive. Answers with revision null must request clarification.

questions.question: At v1.0.0, what does billing.cli.main depend on within two hops?
questions.expected_answer: main calls billing.invoice.total (hop 1); total calls billing.rates.base_rate and billing.tax.apply_tax (hop 2).

questions.question: At v1.1.0, trace the call chain from billing.invoice.total to the rounding helper.
At v1.2.0, which components are affected if billing.rates.base_rate changes?
questions.expected_answer: Direct dependents billing.invoice.total and billing.discount.discounted; transitively billing.cli.main (via total).

questions.question: Which plans did base_rate support in the first release v1.0.0?
questions.expected_answer: Only 'free' (0) and 'pro' (10); 'team' was added later in v1.2.0.

questions.question: What tax multiplier does apply_tax use at v1.3.0, and is the result rounded?
What changed between v1.1.0 and v1.2.0?
questions.expected_answer: Added billing/discount.py (discounted); modified billing/rates.py (base_rate gains 'team': 25); CHANGELOG 1.2.0 section added. No files deleted.

questions.question: What changed between v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 and what do the release notes say?
questions.expected_answer: billing/tax.py modified: round_cents removed, apply_tax now returns amount * 1.25 unrounded. Release notes: 'update VAT rate to 25%'.

questions.question: In which release did the tax rounding fix (#7) first appear?
questions.expected_answer: v1.1.0: round_cents was added and apply_tax started calling it.

questions.question: Is the rounding fix from #7 still present at v1.3.0?
questions.expected_answer: No. It was present in v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 but removed in v1.3.0; apply_tax no longer rounds.

questions.question: What changed in the latest fix?
questions.expected_answer: Unresolved: ask which revision or release (and which fix) is meant; do not guess.

questions.question: At v1.0.0, where is the click library that billing/cli.py imports defined?
questions.expected_answer: Not in this repository: click is an external, unresolved import; only the import statement can be cited.

questions.question: At v1.0.0, what does billing.discount.discounted return?
questions.expected_answer: No evidence at v1.0.0: discounted does not exist there (added in v1.2.0); answer must state the gap rather than use the later revision.
